title: Planning a trip
examples: How do I make sure my budget covers everything?
What is the best way to plan the travel route?
Do I need to worry about time zones when traveling?

explain.say: First we need to think about your budget for the trip.
Next we must plan the travel route between places.
A packing list helps you remember everything you need to take.
Understanding time zones helps you know the correct local time.
For a real trip you must combine these steps carefully.
A common mistake is forgetting to check the weather forecast.

faq.q: How much money should I budget for food?
faq.a: You should budget based on how many meals you plan to eat out. Some places are more expensive than others.
asks: What is a good food budget?
Do I need to save for meals?

faq.q: If I change my route, do I need to change my budget?
faq.a: Yes, changing the route means changing the transport costs. Always check the new travel prices.
asks: How do I adjust my budget for a new route?

faq.q: What is the most important thing to put in my packing list?
faq.a: Your passport and any necessary travel documents are the most important items. Keep them safe at all times.
asks: What should I never forget to pack?
Is my passport enough for the list?

faq.q: If I travel from one time zone to another, what happens to my clock?
faq.a: You need to calculate the time difference between the two locations. This helps you schedule appointments correctly.
asks: How do I calculate time differences?

faq.q: Do I need to budget for emergencies too?
faq.a: Yes, it is wise to set aside a small amount for unexpected costs. This gives you peace of mind during travel.

facts: A budget helps you track all your expected spending.
Routes are planned using different modes of transport like trains or planes.
A packing list keeps track of necessary items for your trip.
Time zones show the difference in local time from a reference point.

quiz.say: If your trip costs $2000, and you plan $500 for accommodation, how much is left for everything else?
quiz.why: You subtract the known cost from the total budget to find the remaining amount.

wrong.0: Only subtracting the first digit is incorrect.
wrong.1: This is a common error when subtracting large numbers.
wrong.3: Adding the cost back makes the total budget too high.

quiz.say: If you travel from London to New York, and London is GMT and New York is GMT minus five, what is the time difference?
quiz.why: New York is five hours behind London, so you must subtract five hours.

wrong.0: This incorrectly doubles the time zone difference.
wrong.2: This confuses the direction of the time shift.
wrong.3: Time zones are rarely the same unless you stay put.

quiz.say: Which item is essential for a packing list for international travel?
quiz.why: Your passport proves your identity and citizenship for crossing borders.

wrong.0: Sunscreen is important, but not required for border crossing.
wrong.1: A book is for entertainment, not travel necessity.
wrong.2: While useful, the passport is the primary document needed.
